edits.before: - Tahm Kench Abyssal Dive: matchup-defining — His re-engage and his escape — all-in only while it is down. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E-Q stun package banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Tahm Kench's Abyssal Dive (W) is down 21s at rank 1, 17s at max — his only engage and escape; all-in only while it's down. - Keep your E-Q stun banked for his best play. - His R Devour needs 3 stacks first — track stacks, not cooldown.

edits.after: Thick Skin and Devour absorb your burst — force them out before committing.
